frequency.description: how often it fires. minutely and hourly count elapsed time; the others count days

interval.description: every nth frequency, such as 2 with weekly for every 2 weeks. Default 1

byDay.description: the weekdays it fires on, such as ["mon","fri"], or {"day":"fri","nth":-1} for the last Friday (monthly or yearly only)

byMonthDay.description: the days of the month it fires on, 1 to 31, or -1 for the last day

byMonth.description: the months it fires in, 1 to 12

at.description: the times of day it fires, HH:MM 24-hour. Daily and longer frequencies need it

starts.description: the date it counts from, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed for an interval above 1, and for a weekly, monthly or yearly schedule that names no day. Otherwise it defaults to the day it is set

hours.description: limits when it may fire to the hours of the day, both ends included, such as {"from":"09:00","until":"17:00"}
